sources.reported: Facade contractor reports 10 m high glass supported by multi-laminated full-height glass fins, and a 23 m wide cantilevered awning. Component figures remain distinct from the earlier 14.5 m estimated overall model height.

sources.observed: Entire displayed daytime front exterior inspected natively. Diamond gold soffit, six slender suspension rods, full-height glass fin edges, thin dark steel canopy beams, translucent panes and dark copper perimeter.
Entire displayed oblique exterior inspected natively. Ribbed oxidised outer cheeks and upper hood, diamond gold returns and soffit, slender suspended canopy and reflective tall glazing.
Entire displayed dusk frontage inspected natively. Golden lining, glass frontage, suspension rods and thin canopy. Dusk appearance is not used as a daytime colour measurement.

Architect describes northern main foyer linking smaller east and west foyers, golden copper hood and 2019 completion. Gallery photo numbered 09 was inspected but is an interior; it was not used as exterior canopy evidence.

Official panorama at 32 High Street, -33.9163674,151.2349538, re-inspected natively. Visible capture February 2022. Corroborates the built hood and entrance-plaza context, partly obscured by mature trees. Does not establish current condition or manufacturing dimensions.

changes.canopy: Replaces the former opaque slab with translucent panes, slim perimeter and transverse beams, fine overhead lines and six suspension rods / fittings. 23 m width follows contractor text; depth 3.95 m, height 3.65 m and small sections are reconstructed. Collision follows its full rectangle above the ground route.
changes.glass: Twelve estimated glazed bays and full-height thin glass fins replace eight generic line divisions. Fin depth 0.48 m, thickness 0.026 m and pane counts are estimates. A static local probe reflects the original reconstructed campus, not source-photo pixels.
changes.copper: Procedural diamond texture now covers the complete repeating tile; local face UVs retain physical scale on sloping soffit and vertical reveals instead of collapsing to world XZ. Estimated 0.5 m diamonds and 0.48 m outer seam spacing. Original procedural pixels only.
changes.views: Two comparison destinations: copper hood / glass fins and suspended entrance canopy.

preserved: Raw source footprints and tags, separately mapped hood outlines, public DEM terrain, ground-level building collision, original main hood envelope and prior 14.5 m overall estimate. Auditorium interiors and artwork remain simplified.

validation.automated: 84 test files passed in the full local suite; targeted new canopy / glazing / UV tests and retained upper-campus tests passed. Syntax and deterministic asset preparation passed.
validation.native: Final preview started successfully with no warnings or errors. Inspected the oblique copper / glazing view after the final reflection and transparency adjustment. Earlier on the same geometry, walked 7 m beneath the suspended canopy to the closed frontage, then 4 m back; shingle pattern, slender beams and transparent panes visible. Roof seam ends are inset from the main lip to retain the estimated 14.5 m maximum.
validation.targeted: Five new geometry / UV / route tests were also run directly and all passed.

limitations: Fine sections, depth, panel count, exact colours and present condition remain uncertain. This is a low-poly exterior reconstruction. Detailed doors, fixings, complete auditorium interior, artwork and current signage remain incomplete.
